svg.title: Animated GitHub contribution heatmap for 2022–2026
svg.desc: A single animated five-year contribution heatmap for FelixKnutsen, generated on 2026-10-31. The snake grows one body segment each time it consumes an active contribution day, then resets for the next loop. 900 total contributions, 153 active days, and a longest streak of 13 days.
svg.text: One square per day · snake grows as it eats active squares · data through 2026-10-31

g.aria-label: Animated snake that grows by one body segment each time it eats an active contribution square
